messages.subject: Pinnacle House - replies to CPSE enquiries
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Replies to your CPSE.1 enquiries attached. Note in particular: option to tax exercised (VAT on rents), block insurance via Caldervale Underwriting, EPC rating B, and the contracting-out position at reply 12. Let me know if you have any follow-ups.

Elena
